purpose: pre-release scan before merging v2.3 into main after the arXiv preprint (arXiv:2610.34644)

scope.tracked_files_at: v2.3 working tree with this record's commit (README and CITATION.cff with the arXiv citation)
also_scanned: the arXiv source package as submitted (extracted)
text of every tracked PDF and of the preprint PDF

Git history: every patch since the test seed commit (2026-10-01) on all branches outside the never-modified results/ and configs/, which covers RESEARCH_PLAN.md, TODO.md and the paper sections deleted on 2026-10-06
scope.files_not_text_note: PDFs (scanned through extracted text) and PNG renderings of the paper figures
scope.file_types: every non-binary file (code, LaTeX, JSON, Markdown, CFF), not only the suffixes scripts/check_public_leaks.py reads

private_material_checked.per_site: campaign executor spec (per-compartment parameters, side-wall exchange, deep-soil temperature, sensor-noise seed, campaign weather year, private paths) and the per-compartment parameters and noise seed of every evaluation year
private_material_checked.sealed_values: test and pilot master seeds, E3 sample seed, and the salts of the three seed openings
private_material_checked.matcher: slowlab.leak_check needles; numeric needles screened by token lookup and confirmed with the original regex

classification.blinding_term/error: words hidden from agents (simulator, noise model, benchmark terms) in code, configs and paper; expected in the repository, not site information
classification.private_path/error: the weather audit file name and the scratch path of the public weather download scripts; not a private run directory
classification.weather_year/warning: public year lists and per-year summaries; see site_year_exposure
classification.site_value/warning: five-significant-digit coincidences with round or unrelated public numbers (distribution bounds and bases, development policies, run times, legacy parameters); no six-digit or full-precision match

site_year_exposure: record names in results/formal_replay_check_20261005.json, results/repair_run_record_20261006.json and results/server2_parity_check_20261005.json (public since 2026-10-04/06) pair a test-site index with one of its evaluation weather years for 9 of 48 sites (10 site-year pairs; each site uses 3 evaluation years from the public pool of 11). The task view built for an agent (slowlab/agent_protocol.py) contains no site index. This corrects the statement in results/public_leak_scan_20261006.json that the years a test site uses are not published.

history_checks.site_values_in_history_since_seed_commit: none (only the weather audit file name and a year remark)

emails_in_tracked_files: the corresponding author's (paper) and the NeurIPS style file author's
conclusion: no test-site parameter, noise seed, sealed seed or salt, credential or private file found in the public material or in the history since the seed commit; no site-to-campaign-year pairing; partial site-to-evaluation-year exposure for 9 sites, low risk, recorded above
site_campaign_year_pairing: checked by searching every site token (siteNN, site_index) within 300 characters of that site's campaign year: three co-occurrences, all coincidental (token counts and another site's evaluation record); no site is paired with its campaign weather year
